name: Harl Vesk, the Raider Captain
place: realm event siege_torborhold: the raid's captain, fought in the open at Torborhold's gate (no arena, no furniture)
_doc: Stream E (play-test 6 U8). The captain of the raid on Torborhold. Before this the siege's boss had NO script and fell back to the Barrow Warden's (defaults.boss.any) — the dungeon boss's name, and a ward that only three braziers can break, in a town street with no braziers: 'he became unkillable'. Harl is a level-3 fight for whoever is in town: a wide axe sweep to step out of, a charge down a line, and at half health he whistles up three raiders (no ward — he keeps fighting). Out of raiders, he fights on with a second, shorter health bar. Nothing in this script needs an object to be there. Enrage 4 min. OWNER #51 (2026-10-15): the phase that refilled the health bar is removed; the health bar is the whole fight.
party: Solo: fair at level 3-4 (step out of the sweep, sidestep the charge). 2-5: the event's own sizing adds health and raiders.

pull: Torborhold! Open your stores and nobody burns.
Take the gate. I'll take the rest.
say.death: Harl Vesk drops his axe. The raiders run for the fields.
say.reset: Harl Vesk spits and walks back to his line.

enrage.say: Harl Vesk has run out of patience!

axe_sweep.name: Axe Sweep
axe_sweep.say: Harl winds up a wide sweep — step back!

gate_charge.name: Gate Charge
gate_charge.say: Harl lowers his shoulder — get out of the line!

phases.name: To Me!
phases.say: To me, you dogs! Earn your share!

onEnter.say: Three raiders answer the whistle. Harl is NOT shielded: keep hitting him or clear them first.
